summary: A campaign's route was set or taken away, so an operation, or the campaign's default, goes to the plugin it names or back to the routes above it.

key.description: The operation the route is for, or `default` for the campaign's default route. A route of one channel of an operation is keyed by that operation, and names its channel in `old` and `new`.

old.description: The route the campaign had for the key before, or null where it had none.

binding.description: The binding the route carried, or null. Its shape is the plugin's own; it names an account and never a credential.

channel.description: The channel the route was for under the operation; absent where the route was the operation's own or the default.

new.description: The route the campaign has for the key now, or null where it was taken away.

binding.description: The binding the route carries, or null. Its shape is the plugin's own; it names an account and never a credential.

channel.description: The channel the route is for under the operation; absent where the route is the operation's own or the default.

anyOf.description: A route set: there may have been one before.
A route taken away: there was one, and there is none now.
